zh-CN.title: 手绘小屋以连续画面苏醒
items: 夜航友间与午后花房取消整幅漂移、随机飘落与拼贴式动画
动物和植物现在通过连续画面自然活动，不再出现裁切边或重影

en.title: The illustrated rooms wake as one continuous scene
items: Rooms at Night and Afternoon Conservatory no longer use whole-scene drift, floating particles, or cutout animation
Animals and plants now move through a continuous image without clipped edges or duplicated artwork
